query:
SELECT EXISTS (
             SELECT 1
             FROM group_grants gg
             JOIN effective_identity_groups ig ON ig.group_id = gg.group_id
             JOIN identities i ON i.id = ig.identity_id
             JOIN groups g ON g.id = gg.group_id
             JOIN service_instances si ON si.id = gg.service_instance_id
             -- Only a pin the instance owner actually owns grants anything:
             -- a pin into someone else's connection must not widen access.
             JOIN connections c ON c.id = si.connection_id
                               AND c.identity_id = si.owner_identity_id
             WHERE ig.identity_id = $1
               AND i.org_id = $2
               AND g.org_id = $2
               AND si.org_id = $2
               AND si.connection_id = $3
         ) AS "has_access!"
